entities.summary: Kevin William O'Connell, nicknamed "KOC", is an American professional football coach and former quarterback who is the head coach for the Minnesota Vikings of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the San Diego State Aztecs from 2004 to 2007 and in the NFL for five seasons from 2008 to 2012, with his longest tenure (2009–2011) as a player with the New York Jets.
